status: candidate: questions and key words written by OpenPath (AI-prepared) on the Reading course's own passages; checked by rule; not reviewed by an educator
evidence: practice-only: writing a short answer to a question on a passage; it changes no capability estimate
format: Each question names a Reading course passage; the answer is right when it holds a word from every key group (simple endings and one-letter slips allowed). The model answer is shown afterwards. What the learner types is never stored.

items.question: What colour was the tomato on Friday?
items.model: The tomato was red on Friday.
items.hint: Look at what happened by Friday.

items.question: Why did Ravi pick the tomato?
items.model: He picked it because it was ripe.
items.hint: Find the word after "because".

items.question: Why was the bus late?
items.model: The bus was late because one tyre was flat.
items.hint: Look for "because".

items.question: Who did Anu sit next to?
items.model: She sat next to her friend Leela.
items.hint: Look at the end of the story.

items.question: Why did Meena let Arul go first?
items.model: She let him go first because he was crying.
items.hint: What was Arul doing at the start?

items.question: What did Uncle Selvam do when the rope slipped?
items.model: He tied a stronger knot.
items.hint: Look at what happened after Meena shouted.

items.question: Why would the kites not rise on Sunday?
items.model: The kites would not rise because the wind was weak.
items.hint: What was the wind like on Sunday?

items.question: What did the shopkeeper give the children?
items.model: He gave each of them a free reel of string.
items.hint: Look at the end of the first part.

items.question: How did Farid get children to bring books?
items.model: He made a chart of names and gave a green dot for each book.
items.hint: What did Farid stick near the door?

items.question: How many books were on the shelf by Friday?
items.model: By Friday the shelf held forty-one books.
items.hint: Look for a number near the end of the second part.

items.question: What was the new rule at Hill View School?
items.model: Children had to bring a steel bottle from home.
items.hint: Read what the head teacher did in April.

items.question: Why did Mr Das have free time after a month?
items.model: He had less litter to collect: only half a sack a week.
items.hint: How many sacks did he fill after a month?

items.question: Why were hundreds of passengers stuck at the station?
items.model: Heavy rain flooded the tracks, so the trains stopped.
items.hint: What happened one July morning?

items.question: Why did the stall earn less than on a normal day?
items.model: Mr Iyer gave free tea to children and old people, and gave money back.
items.hint: What did Mr Iyer give away?

items.question: Why did Suresh's papers reach the houses late?
items.model: He had to walk his round because the bicycle was stolen.
items.hint: What happened to the bicycle?

items.question: How did Suresh keep his customers' trust?
items.model: He wrote a note to each customer to explain the delay.
items.hint: What did he write?

items.question: What did Selvi do to get help for the village?
items.model: She wrote a letter with the measured walk to the district office.
items.hint: What did she send to the district office?

items.question: How did Selvi's uncle show he was proud of her?
items.model: He carried the first pot and left a new pen on her schoolbag.
items.hint: Look at the end of the third part.

items.question: What did Mr Subbiah turn the old bus into?
items.model: He turned it into a library of books for the school.
items.hint: What did he build inside it?

items.question: How did Mr Subbiah's wife's feelings change?
items.model: At first she objected, but now she keeps the borrowing register.
items.hint: What does she do now?

items.question: According to the records, why did students come to the library in the evening?
items.model: They came for the quiet tables and the free internet connection.
items.hint: Read what the librarian's records suggest.

items.question: What did the councillors fear about longer hours?
items.model: They feared it would waste electricity.
items.hint: Look at the first paragraph.

items.question: Why were the shopkeepers against the cycle lane?
items.model: They feared fewer parking spaces would mean fewer customers.
items.hint: Look at the first paragraph.

items.question: Besides the lane, what made cycling feel safe after dark?
items.model: The council repaired the street lights.
items.hint: Read what else the council did that year.
